title: PearlEscape
description: With this plugin, players within the areas you define will be prevented from escaping by getting stuck in blocks using ender pearls.
body:
# PearlEscape Plugin

PearlEscape is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that prevents players from abusing ender pearls to escape or get stuck inside blocks within defined regions.

---

## ✨ Features
- Create custom ender pearl blocked regions  
- Prevent pearl glitches in selected areas  
- Async database system for high performance  
- Simple and easy-to-use commands  

---

## 📌 Commands

- `/pe help` → Shows all commands  
- `/pe create <name>` → Creates a new region  
- `/pe delete <name>` → Deletes a region  
- `/pe list` → Lists all regions  

---

## ⚙️ Performance

All database operations run asynchronously, ensuring smooth performance without causing lag or server freezes.

---

## 🧠 How it works

When a player tries to use an ender pearl inside a protected region, the plugin cancels the teleport action and pushes the player backward, preventing them from entering blocks or escaping the area.

---

## 🚀 Purpose

To keep gameplay fair by preventing ender pearl abuse while maintaining optimal server performance.
